Resolved paths must remain within the resolved selected directory. The source has noDistribution.read_text() calls. algorithm_argument.reason: Resolve and exhaust the selected directory, then iterate explicit-pathimportlib.metadata.distributions. Validate every enumerated distribution with strict file I/O, canonical identity, Version parsing and everyRequires-Dist Requirement, including unreachable ones, before graph traversal. Duplicate canonical names and directURLs fail. Inventory output includes all enumerated validated records.

Every root seeds base plus normalized requested extras. A scheduledstate is inserted at most once. Each popped state evaluates every indexed requirement in that context; first activation enables the fixed target/base/extra set. Induction from roots over activation steps gives coverage of every state and occurrence in the specified least closure. Late extras generate new states, cycles terminate, and active occurrence caching does not lose new extras because each immutable occurrence has fixed extras.

Activation and target seeding precede version checking, so conflicts never prune reachable metadata. A missing target has no outgoing installed metadata and is still a final measured violation. Repeated identical fields retain distinct(name,index)occurrence identities.

Finite parsed inventory/roots yield finitely many target identities and declared extra names. Each state is popped once; the guard raises before the20001st defined processing unit, and a513th distribution fails. Errors exit without a successful logical value. This establishes finite bounded graph work under the authored processing-unit definition, plus runtime/memory/output limits.

After the queue empties, every root and active reachable indexed requirement is checked once using Packaging26.3 contains(Version,prereleases=None). Missing/incompatible targets append violations; inactive markers remain in skipped_requirements; complete=true and satisfied=true occur only after full enumeration, closure and final checks with zero violations.
